settings.title: Shipping & delivery
settings.text: Every order ships worldwide. Each piece is made to order.

settings.title: How long does delivery take?
settings.text: Each piece is made to order: 2–5 business days of production, then transit. France, Europe and the United States arrive within 8 business days. The rest of the world within 10.

settings.title: How do I track my order?
settings.text: A tracking link reaches your inbox the moment your order ships.

settings.title: What is your return policy?
settings.text: You have 30 days from delivery to return or exchange an item. Exchanges are free. For a refund, return shipping is on you and the item price is credited back to your original payment method. Sale pieces are included. Items return unworn, unwashed, with original tags.

settings.title: How do I find my size?
settings.text: Each product page carries its size guide. Between two sizes, size up for the oversized cut.

settings.title: What are the pieces made of?
settings.text: Premium, heavyweight fabrics chosen to hold their shape and last. Refined in Paris. Born everywhere.

settings.title: Which payments do you accept?
settings.text: Major cards and PayPal, through a secure checkout.

settings.title: How do I reach you?
settings.text: Reach us through our contact page. We reply within one business day.
